title: Floating Paradise Kashmir
shortDescription: This thoughtfully planned journey offers a well rounded introduction to Kashmir, blending scenic beauty, cultural landmarks, and relaxed sightseeing.
description: This thoughtfully planned journey offers a well rounded introduction to Kashmir, blending scenic beauty, cultural landmarks, and relaxed sightseeing. From tranquil moments on Dal Lake and garden walks in Srinagar to the alpine meadows of Sonmarg and Gulmarg, the itinerary balances iconic experiences with comfortable pacing.

The route continues through river valleys and countryside landscapes to Pahalgam, allowing time to unwind amidst nature. With guided excursions, smooth transfers, and a memorable houseboat stay, this tour is ideal for travellers seeking a scenic and unhurried exploration of Kashmir’s most loved highlights.

Day trips to Sonmarg, Gulmarg and Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar Airport and meet the representative before proceeding towards the houseboat for check-in. Enjoy a relaxing Shikara ride on Dal Lake, offering beautiful views of the lake, floating markets, and surrounding mountains. Later, visit a local handicrafts showroom known for traditional Kashmiri hand-knotted silk carpets, shawls, and jewellery items. Overnight stay at the houseboat in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Sonmarg – Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to Sonmarg, popularly known as the “Meadow of Gold". Located at an altitude of around 9,000 feet, Sonmarg is surrounded by flower-filled valleys, rivers, and majestic Himalayan mountains. The destination also serves as the base for several high-altitude trekking routes and glacier excursions. Guests may hire ponies at their own expense to visit the famous Thajiwas Glacier, a major attraction during the summer season. Later, drive back to Srinagar for an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Gulmarg, also known as the “Meadow of Flowers", situated at an altitude of approximately 2,730 metres above sea level. Enjoy the scenic drive via Tangmarg, known for its picturesque mountain views. Gulmarg is famous for its ski slopes, scenic landscapes, and one of the world’s highest golf courses. Guests may enjoy a ride on the famous Gulmarg Gondola Cable Car to witness panoramic mountain views; gondola tickets are available on a direct payment basis. Visitors may also opt for a short trek towards Khilanmarg depending on weather and time conditions. Return to Srinagar for an overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Pahalgam – Srinagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed towards Pahalgam via Pampore, known for its saffron fields, and pass through Avantipura and Bijbehara, often referred to as the bread basket of Kashmir. Continue the scenic drive through Anantnag while enjoying beautiful stretches running parallel to the flowing Lidder River. Spend time amidst the peaceful valley surroundings before returning to Srinagar in the evening.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for local sightseeing in Srinagar. Visit the famous Mughal Gardens, including Chashme Shahi, known as the “Royal Spring"; Shalimar Bagh, referred to as the “Garden of Love"; and Nishat Garden, also called the “Garden of Pleasure". Later, visit the revered Shankaracharya Temple, situated on a hilltop overlooking Srinagar and Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar – Airport – Onward destination
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy some free time in Srinagar before proceeding towards Srinagar Airport for your onwards journey. The tour concludes with memorable experiences from Kashmir.
